name: Gästehaus Ludwig Kröll
beschreibung:
Quietly yet centrally located in Mayrhofen, Gaestehaus Ludwig Kroell serves as an excellent home base for skiers and mountaineers. Comfortably furnished rooms offer restful relaxation.

The Penkenbahn and Ahornbahn cable cars, local shops, and hiking bus stops are just an easy walk away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Ludwig Kroell in Mayrhofen features central convenience and alpine comfort in Zillertal.
